tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search ChampionSport.ug news articles about Ugandan sport, the Uganda Premier League, the English Premier League, Champions League, transfers and African football. Returns matching articles with title, excerpt, category, publication date and URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch the full text of one ChampionSport.ug article by its slug (the last part of the URL, e.g. "kcca-fc-win-kampala-derby-2026").

tools.name: list_latest_articles
tools.description: List the most recently published articles on ChampionSport.ug, newest first. Optionally filtered by section (category).

tools.name: get_upl_table
tools.description: Current Uganda Premier League table: position, team, played, won, drawn, lost, goals for and against, goal difference and points. This is the league Ugandan fans follow and which most international sources do not cover in English.

tools.name: list_upl_clubs
tools.description: List Uganda Premier League clubs with their stadium, home city, year founded and capacity.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Upcoming matches in Ugandan sport (no result yet), nearest first: Uganda Premier League, national teams, women's and youth football, rugby, netball, basketball, volleyball and more, from official federation fixture lists. Each match has competition, teams, date and kickoff in East Africa Time (EAT,

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Finished matches with official results in Ugandan sport, newest first. Same filters and fields as get_fixtures, plus the score (or a result text for events without a two-team score) and the result source.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match by its id (from get_fixtures / get_results or a championsport.ug/match/<id> URL): teams, competition, kickoff in EAT and UTC, venue, status, score, sources, match page URL and related ChampionSport.ug articles.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: A team by name (e.g. "Vipers", "SC Villa", "KCCA"): club profile when we have one (nickname, founded, page URL), its most recent results and next fixtures across competitions.
